meta.commentary:
评注 两类曲线积分的关系：设 $F = (P(x,y),Q(x,y))$ ， $e_{\tau} = (\cos \theta ,\sin \theta)$ 是有向曲线 $L$ 的单位切向量，则

$$
\int_ {L} \pmb {F} \cdot \mathrm{d} s = \int_ {L} \pmb {F} \cdot \pmb {e} _ {\tau} \mathrm{d} s \quad \text {或} \quad \int_ {L} P \mathrm{d} x + Q \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {L} (P \cos \theta + Q \sin \theta) \mathrm{d} s .
$$
